titles.title: DELIVER Act of 2025
DELIVER Act of 2025
Delivering Elderly Lunches and Increasing Volunteer Engagement and Reimbursements Act of 2025
To amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to increase the standard charitable mileage rate for delivery of meals to elderly, disabled, frail, and at-risk individuals.

action.text: Referred to the House Committee on Ways and Means.

bill.summary:
Delivering Elderly Lunches and Increasing Volunteer Engagement and Reimbursements Act of 2025 or the DELIVER Act of 2025
This bill increases the standard mileage rate used in calculating the federal tax deduction for the charitable use of a passenger automobile to deliver meals to homebound individuals who are elderly, disabled, frail, or at risk. The bill increases the rate from the standard charitable rate of 14 cents per mile to the standard business mileage rate, which is 70 cents per mile for 2025.
